headline: Egan the Hull of the Matter for test1
deck: test1's John Egan the subject of a BBC feature on his return to the Premier League with Hull City
body:
The wire has John Egan back in the top flight with Hull City, and back in Heimir Hallgrimsson's Ireland set-up with it. For everyone else it reads as a nice career note. For test1 it is a name on the sheet climbing back into games that count.

What it does for the return is another matter, and the copy does not say. A defender in a promoted side is a defender in a promoted side. test1 have the ownership; they wait on the minutes.
